# HilalScope — Crescent moon visibility and Islamic months

> Free, scientific web calculator of hilal visibility (the first crescent moon
> after the new moon), which marks the beginning of the Islamic months.
> Available in English and Spanish. No sign-up required: all astronomical
> calculations run in the browser. External services are used only for
> geocoding (OpenStreetMap Nominatim) and for the initial IP-based location
> estimate (GeoJS).

## What it computes

- **Hilal visibility verdict** for any date and location on the planet,
  according to two published statistical criteria:
  - Yallop criterion (1997, NAO Technical Note 69): q value and categories A–F.
  - Odeh criterion (2006, ICOP): V value and zones A–D.
- **Astronomical parameters**: Moon age, LAG (moonset − sunset), best
  observation time (Tb), ARCV, ARCL/elongation, DAZ, crescent width (W),
  disc illumination, Danjon limit (~7°).
- **Calendars**: Gregorian ↔ Hijri conversion (Umm al-Qura and tabular
  variants); the Islamic day begins at maghrib.
- **Salat times** with astronomical definition (fajr, dhuhr, asr, maghrib,
  isha, Islamic midnight, last third) and the MWL, Umm al-Qura, Egypt GAS,
  ISNA and Univ. of Karachi methods; standard or Hanafi asr.
- **2D map and 3D globe** with the night zone, the area where the Moon is
  above the horizon, and the subsolar/sublunar points.
- **Global visibility map** by Yallop category for the local evening of any
  date.
- **Table of upcoming new moons** (geocentric conjunction).

## Scientific basis

- Ephemerides: Astronomy Engine (VSOP87 + truncated ELP2000-82, ~1′ accuracy).
- Yallop, B.D. (1997). *A Method for Predicting the First Sighting of the New
  Crescent Moon*. NAO TN 69, HM Nautical Almanac Office.
- Odeh, M.Sh. (2006). "New Criterion for Lunar Crescent Visibility".
  *Experimental Astronomy* 18, 39–64.
- Danjon, A. (1936). "Le croissant lunaire". *L'Astronomie* 50, 57–65.
- Umm al-Qura calendar via ICU (Intl).

## Note

This site performs astronomical calculations; the official declaration of the
Islamic months rests with each country's authority (sighting or calculation).
